testEnvironment:
Test environment: the snapshot is a git repository whose single commit holds
the reviewed tree — its tree hash was compared against the commit under review
when the snapshot was cut. A suite run here collects and runs what a checkout at
that commit does, so a failing or skipped test is a fact about the tree, not
about this copy of it. Its history is that one synthetic commit: 'git log',
'git diff' and every ancestry question answer about the snapshot and never about
the PR.
The Recipe's Test entrypoint and Check step do not run these merge-gating CI steps, and nothing in this review ran them: rebase-check job (pull_request-only branch-currency assertion, not meaningful in a worktree of origin/main); proc-macos job (node --test tests/proc.test.mjs on macOS) (subsumed by the full suite on this macOS host); smoke-omp job (needs pinned omp installed via bun, absent here); install-and-smoke job (needs pinned omp installed via bun and network, absent here).

survived.claim: Six tests fail only because the harness exports GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR=true, not because of anything in PR #4299. The env var overrides each fixture's `-c sequence.editor=sed -i.bak s/^pick/edit/`, so the `rebase -i` never stops and the fixture's own 'must be detached' assertion fails. The failing tests: reap.test.mjs:2576 "a [gone] branch held by a worktree stopped mid-`rebase -i` is kept (#2219)"; reap.test.mjs:2596 "a [gone] branch whose holder check cannot read a worktree's rebase state is kept as unknown (#2219)"; release-ticket.test.mjs:3133 "a sibling worktree stopped mid-`rebase -i` on the claim branch halts the delete (#2218)"; release-ticket.test.mjs:3198 "a sibling stopped mid-rebase whose admin HEAD is corrupted still halts the delete, resolved as held (#2218)"; release-ticket.test.mjs:3248 "a prunable sibling that genuinely holds the claim via a stopped rebase still halts the delete (#2218)"; release-ticket.test.mjs:3265 "a sibling's rebase-merge admin subdirectory unsearchable halts the delete as unknown, too (#2218)".
survived.evidence: red: ./agent-test tests/reap.test.mjs tests/release-ticket.test.mjs → exit 1, fail 6 incl all six named tests (tests 421, pass 415; each fails with 'fixture: the worktree/sibling must be detached, or the porcelain `branch` line already answers', the same as the shared run test-run.log:9723-9837); baseline: env -u GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR ./agent-test tests/reap.test.mjs tests/release-ticket.test.mjs → exit 0, tests 421 pass 421, all six named tests pass. Root cause probe (git 2.54.0, scratch repo): `env | grep ^GIT_` prints GIT_EDITOR=true and GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR=true. With them inherited, `git -c sequence.editor='sed -i.bak s/^pick/edit/' rebase -i HEAD~1` prints 'Successfully rebased and updated refs/heads/feat' and `worktree list --porcelain` shows `branch refs/heads/feat`. Under `env -u GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR -u GIT_EDITOR` the same command prints 'Stopped at 7992fbd... # c2' and the listing shows `detached`. The ENV objects at reap.test.mjs:26 and release-ticket.test.mjs:37 spread process.env and clear GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR/GIT_INDEX_FILE but not GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR or GIT_EDITOR. PR #4299 changes no file under tests/ or plugin/ (all 63 diff paths are docs/metrics/**), so this red belongs to the tree on main and the agent environment, not to the PR. It should not block the PR. Reproduce in the worktree before acting.
survived.suggested_fix: In a separate ticket, not this PR: add `GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR: undefined, GIT_EDITOR: undefined` to ENV in tests/reap.test.mjs and tests/release-ticket.test.mjs, or pass the edit editor through env the way reap.test.mjs:3199 and worktree-audit.test.mjs:149 already do. That also keeps reap.test.mjs:2648 ("a worktree mid-rebase of a DIFFERENT branch...") from passing without its fixture, which happens under this env because its rebase never stops either. I did not run a mutant to show that vacuous pass; it is inferred from the probe.

unverified.claim: Scope: the PR creates two new record trees, docs/metrics/runs/ (61 files) and docs/metrics/reviews/4294/ (2 files). No tracked script produces or reads them, and no tracked ADR or component doc defines them. closeout.mjs commits only the three docs/metrics/*.tsv files (METRICS, closeout.mjs:161), so the shape of these files is not pinned by any code or test in this tree.
unverified.evidence: grep `docs/metrics/(runs|reviews)` and `metrics/runs|run-records|catch-up|Rows changed` over copy/plugin, copy/tests, copy/docs/adr, copy/docs/components and ~/.fleet/bin/fleet-run: the only hits are inside the added records themselves, plus the closeout.mjs:418 body template, which has the same 'Rows changed:' shape. Before this PR, docs/metrics held only member-outcomes.tsv, pricing.json, ticket-features.tsv and tier-outcomes.tsv (glob of the copy minus the 63 diff paths = 4 files). The content itself is internally consistent: 0 dangling archive stamps, the files match the local .fleet archives one-to-one, and the only difference is the deliberate redaction.
unverified.suggested_fix: If this record format is meant to last, land its producer and a short doc or ADR (layout: a dir stamp is the rotation time, and its contents describe the run before it) in the same change or one linked to it, so a later reader of docs/metrics/runs/ can find its contract.
